fixture.canvas: Slot dimensions from ACT5_SLOTS_V188; cinematic frames 1280 × 720
fixture.decoding: Native file-path PNG decoding. Buffer decoding fails in this installation; no source conversion, rewrite or derivative is used.
fixture.states: Explicit in-memory saves, resolved by act5CinematicContextV188. These are rendering fixtures, not played or persisted journeys. Extreme count 57 overrides render context only.
fixture.glyphs: Final opaque subtitles, speaker names and captions: tolerance2 per channel, unchanged. Decorative portrait initials behind radio noise are excluded. Native evidence before grain/rain is compared with a second production render omitting only that evidence group. Only FRET in the French bridge primitive has no alpha255 core pixel: its alpha>=192 antialiased core is measured at the same final contribution threshold. Every other evidence text still requires alpha255 core pixels.
fixture.proportionality: New art and reused scene layers are sampled uniformly. The exact existing lower-third speaker crop prescribed by npc-dialogue-portraits-v168 is retained and separately recorded; Rook already maps a 78×80 crop to the 80×80 portrait frame. This exception does not apply to scene actors or new art.
fixture.lateLoad: Minimal declared DOM fixture and real native Canvas. Native Image source assignments are deferred, then mapped to exact local PNG paths; no network is claimed.
fixture.limits: No browser, network, keyboard, combat, reward or save journey. Native text raster is not the browser raster. Art does not complete proposed vehicle/bridge/Queen gameplay.

endingLines: Le dossier part vers l’ICC et les Marshals coloniaux depuis Asphodèle.
Palier « Autonome » : la clause de non-viabilité tombe. Port-Méridien garde sa charte.
Au quai, l’officier des commandos reçoit un appel. L’ICC est saisie depuis Asphodèle : ordre de se retirer. Personne n’a tiré.
epilogue: Le dossier part vers l’ICC et les Marshals coloniaux depuis Asphodèle. Palier « Autonome » : la clause de non-viabilité tombe. Port-Méridien garde sa charte.
Arrivés à Port-Méridien : 11.
CASSIUS reste au service d’Asphodèle, « les vivants d’abord ».
Dossier QZ17 : 5/7. Le signataire du badge reste non établi.
Membres de l’équipage en confiance solide : 10.
La créature capturée reste en cellule au laboratoire du Tantalus.
Le Tantalus se prépare à repartir : la baie cryo rouvre ses caissons.
Casier ECHO-8 : RETOUR CONFIRMÉ.
ECHO-9 · « Je ne sais toujours pas d’où je viens. Je sais où je vais. »

endingLines: The file leaves Asphodèle for the ICC and the Colonial Marshals.
"Autonomous" tier: the non-viability clause falls. Port-Méridien keeps its charter.
At the quay, the commando officer takes a call. The ICC has been referred from Asphodèle: order to withdraw. Nobody fired.
epilogue: The file leaves Asphodèle for the ICC and the Colonial Marshals. "Autonomous" tier: the non-viability clause falls. Port-Méridien keeps its charter.
Arrived at Port-Méridien: 11.
CASSIUS stays in Asphodèle’s service, "the living first".
QZ17 file: 5/7. The badge signer remains unestablished.
Crew members with solid trust: 10.
The captured creature stays in its cell in the Tantalus laboratory.
The Tantalus prepares to leave: the cryo bay reopens its pods.
ECHO-8 locker: RETURN CONFIRMED.
ECHO-9 · "I still don’t know where I’m from. I know where I’m going."

endingLines: La colonie passe sous administration de la compagnie. Inez Harlow démissionne. Le dossier est classé « incident technique ».
epilogue: La colonie passe sous administration de la compagnie. Inez Harlow démissionne. Le dossier est classé « incident technique ».
Arrivés à Port-Méridien : 11.
Asphodèle n’a pas été reprise : la station tourne toujours, feux éteints.
Dossier QZ17 : 5/7. Le signataire du badge reste non établi.
Membres de l’équipage en confiance solide : 10. Inez Harlow quitte le Tantalus.
La créature capturée reste en cellule au laboratoire du Tantalus.
Le Tantalus se prépare à repartir : la baie cryo rouvre ses caissons.
Casier ECHO-8 : POSTE LIBÉRÉ.
ECHO-9 · « Je ne sais toujours pas d’où je viens. Je sais où je vais. »

endingLines: The colony passes under company administration. Inez Harlow resigns. The file is closed as a "technical incident".
epilogue: The colony passes under company administration. Inez Harlow resigns. The file is closed as a "technical incident".
Arrived at Port-Méridien: 11.
Asphodèle was not retaken: the station still turns, lights out.
QZ17 file: 5/7. The badge signer remains unestablished.
Crew members with solid trust: 10. Inez Harlow leaves the Tantalus.
The captured creature stays in its cell in the Tantalus laboratory.
The Tantalus prepares to leave: the cryo bay reopens its pods.
ECHO-8 locker: POST VACATED.
ECHO-9 · "I still don’t know where I’m from. I know where I’m going."

endingLines: La colonie tient cette nuit-là, mais la clause s’applique. La capitaine Vega est relevée à l’arrivée.
Au quai, Echo-9 lit le dossier, pièce par pièce, devant les commandos. À la cinquième, leur officier demande des ordres. Il reçoit celui de se retirer.
Pendant la nuit, une équipe de la compagnie tente de récupérer la créature à bord du Tantalus. L’équipage la repousse au sas du laboratoire.
epilogue: La colonie tient cette nuit-là, mais la clause s’applique. La capitaine Vega est relevée à l’arrivée.
Arrivés à Port-Méridien : 11.
CASSIUS garde la station ; la compagnie réclame son accès administrateur.
Dossier QZ17 : 5/7. Le signataire du badge reste non établi.
Membres de l’équipage en confiance solide : 10. Mara Vega est relevée de son commandement.
La créature capturée reste en cellule au laboratoire du Tantalus.
Le Tantalus se prépare à repartir : la baie cryo rouvre ses caissons.
Casier ECHO-8 : RETOUR CONFIRMÉ.
ECHO-9 · « Je ne sais toujours pas d’où je viens. Je sais où je vais. »

endingLines: The colony holds that night, but the clause applies. Captain Vega is relieved on arrival.
At the quay, Echo-9 reads the file, piece by piece, to the commandos. At the fifth, their officer asks for orders. He is told to withdraw.
During the night, a company team tries to recover the creature aboard the Tantalus. The crew pushes it back at the laboratory airlock.
epilogue: The colony holds that night, but the clause applies. Captain Vega is relieved on arrival.
Arrived at Port-Méridien: 11.
CASSIUS keeps the station; the company demands its administrator access.
QZ17 file: 5/7. The badge signer remains unestablished.
Crew members with solid trust: 10. Mara Vega is relieved of her command.
The captured creature stays in its cell in the Tantalus laboratory.
The Tantalus prepares to leave: the cryo bay reopens its pods.
ECHO-8 locker: RETURN CONFIRMED.
ECHO-9 · "I still don’t know where I’m from. I know where I’m going."

outOfScopeOperationTrace.fixture: Production drawing/preload functions with explicit Canvas/Image doubles. Image metadata uses actual PNG dimensions; measureText deliberately uses 9 units per character identically before and after, as in the preceding review. This compares operation sequences, not raster typography, decoding, browser, network, gameplay or persistence.

observations: The corrected M577 follows the documented two visible wheels, central door and distinct front/rear turrets. The tiny source bottom margin does not visibly truncate the front tire.

The convoy follows APC, colonists, freight. Wheel contacts lie on the inspected top rim; coupling endpoints connect the adjacent vehicles. Four native passengers are visible through the colonist windows.
Halloran order text is readable inside the CRT. The quay confrontation uses weapon-down commando poses and coherent adult scale.
The gate leaves slide from their parked pockets across the real aperture. The cumulative roll-call value remains native.
Four cryopod hoods open in two rows of two, with larger foreground bodies. The sealed ECHO-8 locker remains separate, with both states available in FR/EN.
The final small shuttle in the living ending is visibly clear of the upper letterbox and the right-hand turret. Its transformed rectangle also passes the 1%/99% camera-bound check.
